bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; requiring local approval before Department of Transportation may acquire easements for certain road projects; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 160.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[160.086] LOCAL APPROVAL REQUIRED FOR CERTAIN EASEMENTS. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Definitions.+]

[+(a) For purposes of this section, the following terms have the meanings given. +]

[+(b) "Easement" means the acquisition or designation of private or public land for the purpose of constructing, maintaining, or improving certain project elements related to a road construction project. +]

[+(c) "Local approval" means the approval by a statutory or home rule charter city, county, or town either by: +]

[+(1) a formal resolution adopted by the governing body of the local government unit; or +]

[+(2) a vote at the next general election and, if approved by a majority of those voting on the question, becoming effective following the final canvass of the election. +]

[+(d) "Roadway project elements" means the construction, maintenance, improvement, capacity expansion, reconstruction, resurfacing, or any other development of roadway infrastructure including shoulders, ditches, and culverts for the exclusive use of motor vehicle travel on the trunk highway system. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Local approval required.+]

[+Improvements to a road construction project that are not roadway project elements must receive local approval before funds from sections 85.53, 114D.50, and 129D.17, may be expended to acquire property by easement. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective July 1, 2025, for easements entered into on or after that date. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; requiring local approval before Department of Transportation may acquire easements for certain road projects; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 160.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[160.086] LOCAL APPROVAL REQUIRED FOR CERTAIN EASEMENTS.

Subdivision 1.

Definitions.

(a) For purposes of this section, the following terms have the meanings given.

(b) "Easement" means the acquisition or designation of private or public land for the purpose of constructing, maintaining, or improving certain project elements related to a road construction project.

(c) "Local approval" means the approval by a statutory or home rule charter city, county, or town either by:

(1) a formal resolution adopted by the governing body of the local government unit; or

(2) a vote at the next general election and, if approved by a majority of those voting on the question, becoming effective following the final canvass of the election.

(d) "Roadway project elements" means the construction, maintenance, improvement, capacity expansion, reconstruction, resurfacing, or any other development of roadway infrastructure including shoulders, ditches, and culverts for the exclusive use of motor vehicle travel on the trunk highway system.

Subd. 2.

Local approval required.

Improvements to a road construction project that are not roadway project elements must receive local approval before funds from sections 85.53, 114D.50, and 129D.17, may be expended to acquire property by easement.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective July 1, 2025, for easements entered into on or after that date.
